name: Glen Industries Ltd
tagline: BSE SME: 544444 | Food packaging (PLA/paper straws, containers) for HoReCa, ~Rs 274 Cr - listed status CONFIRMED

Flagged as 'weak quality' based on inconsistent multi-year track record (revenue growth, ROCE, margins, cash conversion, debt-to-cashflow)
fundamentals_narrative: Real above-industry growth (22% CAGR vs 6.79%) in a genuine sustainability-relevant niche (PLA/paper straws for HoReCa, benefiting from single-use plastic restrictions), but an independent quality screen (MoneyWorks4Me) explicitly flags this as 'weak quality' due to an inconsistent multi-year track record - a meaningful caution flag beyond just the headline growth number. The stock has also given back much of its strong listing-day pop.
technical_read: Down from its Rs 157 listing-day close to ~Rs 114 (a ~27% decline), though still above the Rs 97 IPO price - a stock that has cooled significantly since debut.
